title: Cylinder
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector of 0.0, 0.5688, 0.033. On the first face, draw the first loop as a circle centered at (0.0906, 0.0906) with a radius of 0.0906. Draw the second loop as a smaller circle centered at the same point with a radius of 0.0247. Scale the entire two-dimensional sketch by a factor of 0.1812. Transform this scaled sketch into three dimensions using the same Euler angles and translation vector. Extrude the sketch 0.0989 units along the normal direction and 0.0 units in the opposite direction to create a new solid body. This operation results in a cylindrical object with a central hole, named "Cylinder," with a length and width of 0.18120274309829434 units and a height of 0.09890979426762792 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system transformation
translation_vector = (0.0, 0.5688, 0.033)
euler_angles = (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)

# Create the sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").center(0.0906, 0.0906)

# Draw the outer circle
sketch = sketch.circle(0.0906)

# Draw the inner circle (hole)
sketch = sketch.circle(0.0247)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylindrical object
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.0989)

# Apply the coordinate system transformation
cylinder = cylinder.translate(translation_vector).rotate((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), euler_angles[0]) \
                            .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0), euler_angles[1]) \
                            .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), euler_angles[2])

# Final model
r = cylinder

import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system transformation
translation_vector = (0.3344, 0.3344, 0.0)
euler_angles = (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)

# Create the first part (cylinder)
cylinder = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(0.0906, 0.0906)
    .circle(0.0906)
    .extrude(0.0989)
    .translate(translation_vector)
)

# Create the second part (cylinder to be cut)
cut_cylinder = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(0.0495, 0.0495)
    .circle(0.0495)
    .extrude(-0.0495)
    .translate((0.375, 0.375, 0.0989))
)

# Perform the cut operation
r = cylinder.cut(cut_cylinder)

# Define the initial coordinate system transformation
translation_vector = (0.0, 0.0, 0.0989)
euler_angles = (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").center(0.0906, 0.0906)

# Draw the outer circle
sketch = sketch.circle(0.0906)

# Draw the inner circle (hole)
sketch = sketch.circle(0.0495)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder with a hole

# Apply the coordinate system transformation
cylinder_with_hole = cylinder_with_hole.translate(translation_vector).rotate((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), euler_angles[0])
cylinder_with_hole = cylinder_with_hole.rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0), euler_angles[1])
cylinder_with_hole = cylinder_with_hole.rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), euler_angles[2])

# Final model
r = cylinder_with_hole
